structured.answer: I didn't decide anything, and I'm not putting money in from this page. If anything here is close to a deposit it's the "כספי (שקלי)" track: about 4.4 to 4.6% at הראל, מיטב and אלטשולר שחם, with yearly fees of about 0.6 to 0.7% "מהחיסכון". But I'm not sure it's really as safe as a deposit or what those percentages mean, so I'll ask you or the bank first.

stuck.why: Next to the numbers it says '3 שנים 4.38%'. I couldn't tell if that's per year or for all three years, and I wasn't sure I'd read the header right.
